newsitem.title: GERMANY: D.Telekom has no comment on Sprint.
newsitem.headline: D.Telekom has no comment on Sprint.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG, the German phone giant, said on Wednesday it would not comment on a report that Britain's Cable and Wireless was considering making a bid for Sprint Corp of the United States.
Deutsche Telekom and France Telecom each hold ten percent of Sprint and together the three companies operate the Global One international telecommunications alliance.
Cable and Wireless is thought to be preparing a bid for the 80 percent of Sprint not held by the French and German phone companies.
"We have nothing to say about this," a Deutsche Telekom spokesman told Reuters. "We do not comment on speculation."
According to a report in the Wall Street Journal, C&W has held talks with France Telecom on a possible bid for Sprint that could be worth $15 billion.
C&W has declined to comment on the report and France Telecom has denied that it held talks with the British company.
